title: Kenyan Gourmet
text:
Kenyan Gourmet
SA Expeditions

Kenyan cuisine is a vibrant blend of flavors, reflecting the country's diverse ethnic groups. The coastal region offers tantalizing dishes like biryani, a fragrant rice dish typically prepared with meat or seafood. Explore the influence of` Indian cuisine with dishes like chapati (unleavened bread) and samosas (flaky pastry filled with savory fillings). 

Inland, Kenyan staples like ugali (maize meal) and sukuma wiki (collard greens) take center stage, often served alongside nyama choma (grilled meat) or irio (a mixture of mashed potatoes, peas, corn, and greens). Delve into the thriving street food scene, where vendors serve up mouthwatering treats such as viazi karai (deep-fried potatoes) and mandazi (sweet fried bread). End your culinary journey with a cup of Kenyan tea, known for its strong flavor and aromatic qualities.
